features.name: Size
features.description: Elves range from under 5 to over 6 feet tall and have slender builds. Your size is Medium.

features.name: Speed
features.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Accustomed to twilit forests and the night sky, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

features.name: Trance
features.description: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day.

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish. Elvish is fluid, with subtle intonations and intricate grammar.
